The '''Novare Coast''' was an area located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denova]]. It was a major battlefield in the fighting on the planet during the [[Galactic War]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Novare Coast appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a player vs. player Warzone.
